title: Testing Superposition Signatures in Safety-Relevant Layers
original_idea: Using TransformerLens on GPT-2 Small, measure proxies for superposition in each layer: kurtosis, condition number, PCA capture fraction. Compare between safety-relevant layers and neutral layers.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Reasonable theory linking superposition to interpretability difficulty in safety-critical layers, but the safety-relevance of GPT-2 Small layers for 'refusal' is arguable since GPT-2 was not RLHF-trained.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Computing kurtosis and PCA is straightforward, but identifying 'safety-relevant' layers via ablation on refusal-style prompts is non-trivial for beginners since GPT-2 Small lacks refusal behavior.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear metrics (kurtosis, condition number, PCA fraction) and comparison structure. Slightly weakened by ambiguity in defining safety-relevant layers.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
